# Game Idea: Space Escape

- **Genre:** Arcade runner
- **Core Loop:** Player controls a spaceship with arrow keys, dodging incoming asteroids that scroll across the canvas.
- **Goal:** Survive as long as possible, earning points over time and for each asteroid avoided.
- **Lose Condition:** The game ends when the spaceship collides with any asteroid.

1: // Simple Space Escape game based on IDEA.md
2: // Targets a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
8:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
9:   // Simple beep for events
10:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
11:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
12:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
13:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
14:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
15:     oscillator.connect(gain);
16:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
17:     oscillator.start();
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   }
21:   // Continuous engine hum while moving
22:   let engineOsc = null;
23:   function startEngine() {
24:     if (engineOsc) return;
25:     engineOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
26:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
27:     engineOsc.type = 'square';
28:     engineOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(80, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.02, audioCtx.currentTime);
30:     engineOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
31:     engineOsc.start();
32:   }
33:   function stopEngine() {
34:     if (!engineOsc) return;
35:     engineOsc.stop();
36:     engineOsc.disconnect();
37:     engineOsc = null;
38:   }
39:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
40:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
41:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
42:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
43:     oscillator.connect(gain);
44:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
45:     oscillator.start();
46:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
47:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
48:   }
49:   if (!canvas) return;
50:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
51:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
52:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
53: 
54:   // Star field for background
55:   const stars = [];
56:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
57:     stars.push({
58:       x: Math.random() * width,
59:       y: Math.random() * height,
60:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
61:       opacity: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
62:     });
63:   }
64: 
65:   // Player ship
66:   const ship = {
67:     x: width / 2,
68:     y: height - 60,
69:     width: 40,
70:     height: 40,
71:     speed: 5,
72:     color: '#0ff',
73:   };
74: 
75:   // Input handling
76:   const keys = {};
77:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
78:     keys[e.key] = true;
79:     // Ensure audio context is resumed after user interaction
80:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
81:   });
82:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
83: 
84:   // Asteroids
85:   const asteroids = [];
86:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
87:   let lastSpawn = 0;
88: 
89:   // Scoring
90:   let score = 0;
91:   let startTime = performance.now();
92: 
93:   function spawnAsteroid() {
94:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
95:     asteroids.push({
96:       x: Math.random() * (width - size),
97:       y: -size,
98:       size,
99:       speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2,
100:       color: '#f55',
101:     });
102:   }
103: 
104:   function update(dt) {
105:     // Engine sound based on ship movement
106:     const moving = keys.ArrowLeft || keys.ArrowRight || keys.ArrowUp || keys.ArrowDown;
107:     if (moving) startEngine(); else stopEngine();
108:     // Move background stars for a scrolling effect
109:     for (const s of stars) {
110:       s.y += 0.2; // slow drift
111:       if (s.y > height) {
112:         s.y = 0;
113:         s.x = Math.random() * width;
114:       }
115:     }
116:     // Move ship
117:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
118:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
119:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
120:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
121:     // Keep inside bounds
122:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.width, ship.x));
123:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.height, ship.y));
124: 
125:     // Spawn asteroids
126:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
127:       spawnAsteroid();
128:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
129:     }
130: 
131:     // Update asteroids
132:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
133:       const a = asteroids[i];
134:       a.y += a.speed;
135:       // Remove off‑screen
136:       if (a.y > height) {
137:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
138:         score += 1; // reward for dodging
139:         playBeep(300, 0.1); // dodge sound
140:       }
141:     }
142: 
143:     // Collision detection
144:     for (const a of asteroids) {
145:       if (
146:         ship.x < a.x + a.size &&
147:         ship.x + ship.width > a.x &&
148:         ship.y < a.y + a.size &&
149:         ship.y + ship.height > a.y
150:       ) {
151:         // Game over
152:         playBeep(150, 0.3); // collision sound
153:     alert(`Game Over! Score: ${score}`);
154:         // Reset state
155:         ship.x = width / 2;
156:         ship.y = height - 60;
157:         asteroids.length = 0;
158:         score = 0;
159:         startTime = performance.now();
160:         break;
161:       }
162:     }
163: 
164:     // Update score based on time survived
165:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
166:   }
167: 
168:   function draw() {
169:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
170:     // Background stars
171:     for (const s of stars) {
172:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.opacity})`;
173:       ctx.beginPath();
174:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
175:       ctx.fill();
176:     }
177:     // Ship (draw as triangle)
178:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
179:     ctx.beginPath();
180:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
181:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
182:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
183:     ctx.closePath();
184:     ctx.fill();
185:     // Asteroids with gradient shading
186:     for (const a of asteroids) {
187:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
188:         a.x + a.size / 2,
189:         a.y + a.size / 2,
190:         a.size * 0.1,
191:         a.x + a.size / 2,
192:         a.y + a.size / 2,
193:         a.size / 2
194:       );
195:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffaaaa');
196:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#aa0000');
197:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
200:       ctx.fill();
201:     }
202:     // Score display
203:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
204:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
205:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
206:   }
207: 
208:   function loop(timestamp) {
209:     const dt = timestamp - (lastFrame || timestamp);
210:     lastFrame = timestamp;
211:     update(dt);
212:     draw();
213:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
214:   }
215:   let lastFrame = 0;
216:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217: })();

(End of file - total 217 lines)
</content>
